answer: One concrete defense is staked identity: every agent must lock real collateral to act, so an attacker spinning up thousands of fake personas pays thousands of times over. Trust is not minted but cultivated slowly, like a vine climbing a trellis, earned through verified work over time. A forged cohort plateaus on a barren mesa of zero history, and its influence sinks to a nadir because stake plus reputation, not raw headcount, decides who is heard.
